contracts_checked: The added success path requires exactly one flavor selector, whose value is lld, and exactly one linker-path selector whose value is absolute.
The existing subsequent basename check still requires ld.lld and the selected path must identify a file.
Duplicated equals-form flavor or path selectors and mixed conflicting flavor/path values miss the new success path and fail the unchanged single-selection gate.
The patch does not modify link_argv or strip either driver selector. The actual compiler invocation still uses both production arguments in their original order.

The explicit absolute linker path becomes the selected linker and is inserted into files. issue_receipt digests that exact file, resolves any symlink, captures file identity, and verify_receipt rechecks it before and after anonymous execution.
The selected LLD resource remains used by the link command and is retained in resource-tree fingerprinting; this patch does not change TOOL_ROOT exclusion.
Production build/platform/lld/ya.make:44-48 emits the same complementary Linux selector pair.

No changes occur in compile/link template adaptation, no-disk-emission checks, anonymous output descriptors, --no-mmap-output-file, environment transport, TMPDIR, diagnostic hashing, or guard cleanup.
selector_analysis_scope: Equals-form selectors used by the observed production command. Existing single-selector fallbacks are preserved; this review does not claim a general Clang driver-option parser.
limitations: Actual graph details were taken from the adapter author's bounded read-only inspection record and corroborated with the Linux build source; this reviewer did not reload the large graph during the active guarded build.
Metadata capture must still pass against the actual successful closure build and installed linker. No compiler, linker, native, or mock execution was performed in this review.
This adapter enables accurate linker binding; it does not establish C31 runtime correctness or replace the pending direct contract checks.
